why: Twelve of the twenty-seven people on the Black Panther Political Prisoners list carry an institution that is impossible for them -- a federal prison in the wrong state, a jail in Oregon for a Nebraska prisoner, a Pennsylvania state prison for a woman held in New Jersey. Four are replaced with the facility the record clearly belongs to; the other nine are cleared, because removing a false published fact is right even when the true one is not yet known.
contamination_note: These bad values are not random one-offs. Fourteen institutions in this database hold sets of cases that cannot belong together -- people from eight to twelve different states and eras spanning up to three centuries, at facilities that in some cases did not exist yet. FCI Allenwood, FCI Petersburg, FCI Marianna, FCI Waseca, FCI Oxford, Ashland FCI, Albany Penitentiary, Lane County Jail, SCI Dallas, West Tennessee State Penitentiary, MCC Chicago, Edna Mahan, Butler County Prison and Norfolk County Jail. Together they carry about 180 case rows, of which this batch fixes 13. The rest is a separate job.
method_note: Each entry matches on the wrong institution name, so the batch is idempotent: once a row is fixed it no longer matches and is skipped. Nothing else on the case is touched -- dates, charges, sentence and conviction text are left exactly as they are.
